preprocessing.description: Decode to RGB, bicubic-resize the shorter edge to 224, center-crop 224x224, then apply (raw_pixel - mean) * scale per channel using the tensor contract constants. Metadata is not an input.

producer.description: Export only the ViT-B/32 image encoder at fixed batch and resolution, then L2-normalize its 512-component output inside the graph. Text prompts and zero-shot label policy remain outside the model artifact.

evaluation.description: Minimum native-versus-portable cosine similarity on the frozen image holdout.
Minimum native-versus-portable agreement for the same frozen, reviewed prompt set.
No NaN or infinite embedding component is accepted.

tpu.reason: Needs image-encoder export, representative fully-int8 calibration, full Edge TPU mapping, semantic parity and Coral execution evidence.

npu.reason: Needs a fixed image-only ONNX export plus semantic parity and execution evidence on the selected OpenVINO NPU.

gpu.reason: Needs a fixed image-only TorchScript export plus semantic parity and execution evidence through ncnn/Vulkan.
